cases.why: the SHELF RECORD itself: ce-workshop/ce-parts/screw-m2.5-iso4762/cad/interfaces.json, interface 'thread_ext', loaded off disk unmodified. It carries the frame read off the built solid and a thread object {designation, pitch_mm}, which is exactly what mate() and compat() read. This case is the seam between the connection and the part, and it did not exist before 2026-09-04 because that folder had no interfaces at all.
